MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING
  DECEMBER 17, 2025
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  3:30 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Riggins called the meeting to order at 3:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Marianne Riggins; Mayor Pro Tern Bruce Silverstein; and
  Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad, Doug Stewart and Steve Uhring.

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Rob DuBoux, Acting City
  Manager; Parker Davis, Media Technician; Christina Mufioz, Deputy City Clerk; Jason
  Lawrence, Deputy City Clerk

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Councilmember Uhring moved, and Councilmember Stewart seconded a motion to
  approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried unanimously.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Deputy City Clerk Muiloz reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  December 12, 2025.

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Anne K.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

  At 3:30 p.m., the Council recessed to Closed Session to discuss the following items listed
  on the Closed Session agenda:

personnel Matters pursuant to Government Code Section 54957:
  1.  Public Employee Appointment
  Title: City Manager

  2.  Public Employee Appointment
  Title: Interim City Manager
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of December 17,.2025
  Page 2 of 3

Conference with Labor Negotiator pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6:

  1.  City representative: Interim City Attorney Trevor Rusin
  Unrepresented employee: City Manager

  2.  City representative: Interim City Attorney Trevor Rusin
  Unrepresented employee: Interim City Manager

  Mayor Riggins called the meeting to order at 4:37 p.m.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  Interim City Attorney Rusin reported that the meeting convened at 3:30 p.m., after which
  time the City Council recessed to a Closed Session pursuant to Government Code Section
  54957 and 54957.6, with all Councilmembers present. He stated the Council discussed the
  items on the Closed Session agenda and decided by unanimous vote of the City Council to
  appoint Acting City Manager Rob DuBoux as Interim City Manager upon the resignation
  of Interim City Manager Candace Bond, until a permanent begins or Interim City Manager
  is appointed.

ITEM 1  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Appointment of Joe Irvin as City Manager and Related City Manager Employment
  Agreement

  Recommended Action: Appoint Joe Irvin as City Manager, effective March 2,
  2026, and authorize the Mayor to sign the attached City Manager Employment
  Agreement.

  Interim City Attorney Rusin presented the staff report.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor to public comment.

  Speaker: Anne K.

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the
  table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item.

MOTION  Councilmember Stewart moved, and Councilmember Conrad seconded a motion to
  appoint Joe Irvin as City Manager, effective March 2, 2026, and authorize the
  Mayor to sign the attached City Manager Employment Agreement. The question
  was called, and the motion carried unanimously.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of December 17, 2025
  Page 3 of 3

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Riggins adjourned the meeting at 4:45 p.m.

  Approved and adopted by the City Council of the
  City of Mar on August 10, 2026.

  BRUCE  VERSTEIN, Mayor
